name: Intra Balance Modification 8
definition: Provides the details of the modification requests.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

CashAccountServicer.name: Cash Account Servicer
CashAccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the cash account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Status and status reason of the transaction.

RequestReference.name: Request Reference
RequestReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the modification request.

StatusDate.name: Status Date
StatusDate.definition: Date and time at which the status was assigned.

RequestDetails.name: Request Details
RequestDetails.definition: Details of the request providing the changes and references of the instruction for which the modification is requested.

UnderlyingIntraBalance.name: Underlying Intra Balance
UnderlyingIntraBalance.definition: Identifies additional details of the transaction.
